info.title: Scene Manager
info.description: Scene Manager's local API, on the computer it runs on. Every call needs a Scene Manager licence on this computer.

licensed.description: Whether Scene Manager may be used on this computer: without a licence every other call answers 402

pid.description: The connected app's process: Scene Manager works with one app at a time

names.description: Counts renames, additions and removals in the app: names and what is missing are read again when it moves

busy.description: What the app is busy with (a file opening or saving, a merge, an import or export, a render): changes are refused until it is done

generation.description: Counts the scenes read: a document written for another (PUT /document's X-Scene-Generation) is refused

helper.description: The command an agent runs to wait for the next comment (this service's own executable): `<it> --for <name> --seconds <n>`

revision.description: Counts the document's changes: PUT /document with If-Match set to it is refused (409, conflict) once another write came in between

unreadable.description: Why the scene's document could not be read; while set, the document is empty and nothing is written

SceneDocument.description: The scene's Scene Manager document (format `scenemanager`, integer `version`).

get.description: Answers when a new open comment for the agent arrives (assigned to it or to Agent, or mentioning @it or @Agent), or a thread it took gets a reply, or `seconds` pass with nothing (`comments` empty). The body is kept alive with blank space while it waits, so an agent can run it in the background (`curl -s`) and be woken when it ends.
